# Alfaz Khan Portfolio Website

> Personal portfolio and resume site for Alfaz Khan, a Frontend Engineer (React & TypeScript) based in Munich, Germany, showcasing full-stack data analytics work and the 2Subs2Learn browser extension.

Key notes:
- Static Next.js 16 + React 19 application styled with Chakra UI v3 (`light` and `dark` color modes).
- Contact: `khanalfaaz14@gmail.com` | `+49 15510 311484` | München, Bavaria, Germany (Work status: Available).
- Interactive pages register WebMCP tools via `document.modelContext.registerTool` when supported by the browser.
- Authoritative machine-readable resource index: `/.well-known/ard.json`.

## Pages & Endpoints

- [Portfolio Homepage](https://www.theonlyalfaz.com/): Introduction, works/projects, education & experience timeline, skills marquee, and contact info.
- [2Subs2Learn Product Page](https://2subs2learn.theonlyalfaz.com): Dedicated landing page for the Manifest V3 bilingual subtitle browser extension (also served at https://www.theonlyalfaz.com/2subs2learn).
- [Resume (English)](https://www.theonlyalfaz.com/resume/en): Static redirect to Alfaz Khan's English CV on Google Drive.
- [Resume (German / Deutsch)](https://www.theonlyalfaz.com/resume/de): Static redirect to Alfaz Khan's German Lebenslauf on Google Drive.

## Machine-Readable Discovery

- [ARD Manifest](https://www.theonlyalfaz.com/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery (v0.91) catalog for domain capabilities and cards.
- [Portfolio Agent Card](https://www.theonlyalfaz.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): Structured JSON summary of profile, routes, contact links, and WebMCP tool names.
- [2Subs2Learn Agent Card](https://www.theonlyalfaz.com/.well-known/2subs2learn-card.json): Structured JSON summary of 2Subs2Learn store links, platforms, and tech stack.

## Featured Projects

- [2Subs2Learn](https://2subs2learn.theonlyalfaz.com): Manifest V3 TypeScript/WXT browser extension for dual-subtitle playback on YouTube and ZDF Mediathek using browser-side Transformers.js & ONNX Runtime Web ([GitHub](https://github.com/alfazkhan/2Subs2Learn), [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/egkapkomakndamdhmlgknamdhmfnmkbf), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/2subs2learn/)).
- [Subreddit Analyzer](https://subanalyzer.theonlyalfaz.com): Full-stack Reddit analysis platform with a React dashboard, Python FastAPI backend, NLP pipelines, PostgreSQL storage, and Apache ECharts ([GitHub](https://github.com/alfazkhan/Subreddit-Analyzer)).
